title: The Crystal Collection
subtitle: Vida Mía at The Retreat
intro: Every stone in our collection has a story. Touch one and it will tell you.

shoutout.name: Santosha

shoutout.text: Our boutique at The Retreat, with necklaces, rings, clothing and more to take a little of this place home with you.

crystals.name: Amethyst

story.title: A name against excess
story.text: The word comes from the ancient Greek amethystos, meaning "not intoxicated". Greeks carved drinking cups from it, believing the stone kept the drinker clear headed.

story.title: Where it comes from
story.text: Amethyst is quartz coloured purple by traces of iron and natural radiation in the earth. Most of it grows inside volcanic geodes in Brazil and Uruguay.

story.title: What it is known for
story.text: It is traditionally kept close for calm, quiet sleep and a clear mind. Many people place it by the bed or in a meditation corner.

crystals.care: Keep it out of long direct sunlight, which slowly fades the purple.

crystals.name: Rose Quartz

story.title: The colour of a blush
story.text: Its soft pink comes from microscopic mineral fibres trapped inside the quartz as it formed, which is why it glows rather than sparkles.

story.title: What it is known for
story.text: Often called the stone of the heart, rose quartz is given as a token of love, friendship and self care.

crystals.care: Like amethyst, its colour can fade in strong sun.

crystals.name: Clear Quartz

story.title: Ice that never melts
story.text: The ancient Greeks called it krystallos, ice, believing it was water frozen so deeply it could never thaw. Our word crystal comes from it.

story.title: Close to home
story.text: The Retreat sits atop a quartz mountain, so this is the stone beneath your feet during your stay.

story.title: What it is known for
story.text: Quartz keeps time inside watches thanks to its steady vibration. In crystal practice it is the stone of focus, used to set an intention.

crystals.care: Rinse with water and dry with a soft cloth.

crystals.name: Citrine

story.title: Named after a lemon
story.text: Citrine takes its name from the French citron. Natural citrine is rare, and much of what is sold is amethyst warmed until it turns gold.

story.title: What it is known for
story.text: Sunny and warm, it is associated with abundance and is often kept near a workspace or a cash box.

crystals.care: Store it away from strong sun to keep its colour.

crystals.name: Black Tourmaline

story.title: The ash puller
story.text: Dutch traders in the 1700s noticed that warm tourmaline attracts ash, and used it to clean their pipes. They called it aschentrekker.

story.title: What it is known for
story.text: Its deep black made it a stone of protection and grounding, often placed by the front door.

crystals.care: Wipe clean with a dry cloth.

crystals.name: Selenite

story.title: A stone named for the moon
story.text: Selenite is named after Selene, the Greek goddess of the moon, for its soft, pearly light.

story.title: Giants underground
story.text: In the Cave of the Crystals in Naica, Mexico, selenite beams grow longer than a bus.

story.title: What it is known for
story.text: It is used to cleanse other crystals and to bring a calm, clear energy to a room.

crystals.care: Very soft and sensitive to water. Keep it dry and dust it gently.
